answer: Each submission hangs on the pearl of a task receipt, and the wharf is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
